name: Loam Data
description:
Loam is the database for Claude. Add the business data you already have, then ask questions in plain English and get answers grounded in real rows.

Upload CSV, Excel, Parquet, TSV, and JSON files, or connect supported data sources. Claude can use Loam to analyze revenue, pipeline, campaigns, operations, and other business data without relying on pasted snapshots or prebuilt dashboards.

Ask questions such as:
• Which region had the highest revenue last quarter?
• What changed most between this month’s export and last month’s?
• Which products have the highest return rate?

You stay in control. When connecting Claude, you choose the Loam account it will use. Loam checks that account’s current permissions whenever Claude asks a question, so Claude can access only the data that account is allowed to use.

Loam is built for founders and teams that want useful answers from their business data without waiting for a data team.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Loam Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Loam Data to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.loamdata.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Loam Data MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Loam Data lists 16 MCP tools, including commit_ingestion_upload, complete_ingestion_upload, create_ingestion_pipeline, create_ingestion_upload, describe_table, execute_sql_mutation, execute_sql_query, get_ingestion_run, get_loam_help, get_sql_reference, list_ingestion_pipelines, and list_ingestion_run_errors.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Loam Data?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Loam Data in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Loam Data MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Loam Data requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Loam Data is developed by Shipit Software. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
